title: CRE Skills Plugin Catalog
description: Canonical source of truth for all plugin items: skills, agents, commands, calculators, workflows, and orchestrators.

mcp_tools.description: MCP tool inventory parsed from src/mcp-server.mjs (name + description).

id.description: Unique identifier (slug for skills/commands, filename stem for agents/calculators)

source_path.description: Relative path from repo root to the item's primary file

persona.description: Brief description of the item's role or persona

lifecycle_phase.description: Where in the CRE lifecycle this item operates

intent_triggers.description: Phrases that should route to this item

input_artifacts.description: Types of input documents or data this item expects (e.g., OM, rent roll, lease)

downstream_items.description: Item IDs that typically follow this item in a workflow

upstream_items.description: Item IDs that typically precede this item

hidden_from_default_catalog.description: If true, excluded from default routing and navigation

legacy_wrapper_for.description: If this item is a backward-compat wrapper, the ID of the item it wraps

calculator_file.description: Path to associated Python calculator, if any

classification.description: v5 agent-ecosystem role subdividing `type`. Derived by catalog-build.py; SKILL.md frontmatter overrides. See docs/architecture/v5-micro-skill-architecture.md §2.

runtime_role.description: v5 execution role. Derived from classification with frontmatter override. See §2.

decision_grade.description: Can emit a decision-grade artifact (IC memo, valuation, LP report, waterfall). Catalog projection of SKILL.md frontmatter `final_marked`. See §3, §10/M-A3.

human_gate.description: CRE-business-semantic human sign-off required before the output is acted on. See §3, §10/M-AM2.

source_ref_policy.description: Source-grounding posture (09 shape). Required for AMOS-facing / decision-grade skills. See §10/M-D2.

emits.description: Source-ref namespaces this skill emits (e.g., data-room/*, model/*).

on_unresolvable.description: Behavior when a required source reference cannot be resolved.

forbids_fabricated_model_ref.description: If true, the skill must never invent a model/* or data-room/* reference.

amos_surface.description: AMOS RoomTabKey (+ landing) placement. Source of truth: amos-prototype room-tabs.ts. See §3, §10/M-AM1.

decomposes_to.description: Catalog item ids this orchestrator/workspace composes. Required when classification in {orchestrator, workspace}. See §4.1, §4.5.

composed_from.description: Inverse pointer: orchestrators/workspaces that use this item. Ids resolve to real catalog items. See §4.5.

produces_artifact_kind.description: v5.2 consumer-contract field. Plugin-namespaced artifact family the item emits. Derived (calculator_file -> calculator_result, orchestrator -> workflow_plan) with SKILL.md frontmatter override. null where not yet declared. Plugin vocabulary, NOT a downstream consumer's internal artifact registry.

pii_policy.description: v5.2 consumer-contract field. Maximum PII/confidentiality sensitivity the item is expected to encounter in inputs. CONSERVATIVE default 'none' (explicit-opt-in). PHI is intentionally NOT a value: CRE Skills do not accept PHI. Sensitivity ladder, distinct from the connector data-trust source_class vocabulary.

workspace_scope.description: v5.2 consumer-contract field. CRE workspace the item operates within, for downstream filtering/grouping. Derived from subcategory/keywords with frontmatter override. null where unscoped.
